subject: Computer Science
source_note: TIE (2023), Computer Science Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the basic Concepts of Computer Science

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of the concept of Computer Science
competences: (a) Describe the concept of Computer Science (meaning, importance, application)
(b) Describe fields related to Computer Science (IT, ICT, IS, Computer Engineering)

objectives.text: (a) Describe the concept of Computer Science (meaning, importance, application)
objectives.resources: Handouts with contents of Computer Science concepts
objectives.assessment_criteria: Confidently describe the concept of Computer Science field

objectives.text: (b) Describe fields related to Computer Science (IT, ICT, IS, Computer Engineering)
objectives.teaching_methods: Question and answer, guest speaker; and/or case study
objectives.assessment_criteria: Confidently describe fields related to Computer Science

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate an understanding of computer systems
competences: (a) Describe computer systems (Meaning, types, functions, and significance)
(b) Describe computer hardware (meaning, components, functions, computer generation)
(d) Describe and observe principles of computer system handling (safety measures, management, cleanliness, data backup and utilities)

objectives.text: (a) Describe computer systems (Meaning, types, functions, and significance)
objectives.resources: Computer, Hand-out, Flip board and digital podium, electronic blackboard

objectives.text: (b) Describe computer hardware (meaning, components, functions, computer generation)
objectives.resources: Computer, printer, scaner, camera, projector, flashdisk, hard disk memory card, smart phone, tablets and motherboard
objectives.assessment_criteria: Realise parts of computer hardware and their functions
Realise types of computer software and their functions

objectives.text: (d) Describe and observe principles of computer system handling (safety measures, management, cleanliness, data backup and utilities)
objectives.resources: Computer, printer, scaner, projector, flashdisk, memory card, smart phone, tablets and hard disk
objectives.assessment_criteria: Clearly observe principles of handling the computer system

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of maintenance and troubleshooting of computer system
competences: (b) Organise computer files in different operating systems (windows, Linux, etc)

objectives.resources: Computer, CDs with different software, hand out and dard disk

objectives.text: (b) Organise computer files in different operating systems (windows, Linux, etc)
objectives.resources: Computer installed with recommended OSs, hand out, simulated steps videos and smart phone
objectives.assessment_criteria: Can use operating systems to organise computer files

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the basic principles of Computer Science

sub_topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of the basic principles in problem solving (concept of problem solving, steps of problem solving, concept of algorithms)
competences: (a) Describe the steps in solving a problem using computers
(b) Demonstrate an understanding of basic principle of algorithms
(c) Design and present a single algorithm using flow charts and pseudocode

objectives.text: (a) Describe the steps in solving a problem using computers
objectives.teaching_methods: Brainstorming, the steps of solving a problem using computer
objectives.resources: Computer, smart phone, hand outs of of the basic principles in problem solving and tablets
objectives.assessment_criteria: Clearly describe the steps of solving a problem using computer

objectives.text: (b) Demonstrate an understanding of basic principle of algorithms
objectives.assessment_criteria: Clearly explain how the algorithm can be used to address problems

objectives.text: (c) Design and present a single algorithm using flow charts and pseudocode
objectives.assessment_criteria: Confidently can apply algorithms to present new ways to address problems
